priorityList: Use Potions and offensive Trinkets during Metamorphosis for maximum burst alignment.
Cast Void Ray to maintain the Eradicate buff in AoE situations.
At maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks, prioritize casting Voidblade and The Hunt.
Cast Metamorphosis, ideally while the Eradicate buff is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil when Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Use Reap, Cull, or Eradicate if Metamorphosis is active and you have consumed at least 4 souls.
Use Reap, Cull, or Eradicate immediately if the Voidfall Spending proc is active or Eradicate is down in AoE.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Cast Collapsing Star when available, prioritizing usage at high stack counts or when Voidblade is on cooldown.
Maintain Soul Immolation on multiple targets when Metamorphosis is inactive.
Use Vengeful Retreat when the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Hungering Slash as your primary filler in AoE combat.
Cast Reaper's Toll if the Voidsurge proc is active or when fighting multiple enemies.
Cast Predator's Wake and Pierce the Veil on cooldown to generate resources and procs.
Use Devour and Consume as fillers when no higher-priority abilities are available.
